title: Firewall → Aliases, NAT → Port Forward and Settings → Categories

items.description: A firewall alias (Firewall → Aliases). Changes are applied (reconfigured) after every write.

name.description: Alias name: letters, digits and underscores, at most 32 characters.
validators: stringvalidator.RegexMatches(aliasNameRe, "must be 1-32 letters, digits or underscores")

content.description: Entries: hosts, networks, ports, URLs or nested alias names, depending on type.

proto.description: IPv4 and/or IPv6, for geoip and asn aliases.

updatefreq.description: Refresh interval in days for url and urltable aliases.

password.description: Password or token for url aliases behind authentication.

username.description: User name for url aliases behind authentication.

items.description: A category that groups firewall rules, NAT rules and aliases. Categories cannot be deleted while in use.

auto.description: Created automatically (e.g. by a plugin); removed when unused.

items.description: An interface group (Firewall → Groups): a named set of interfaces that rules can use like one interface.

ifname.description: Group name (letters, digits; shown as the interface name in rules).

nogroup.description: Do not use the group as a pf interface group (only for the UI).

sequence.description: Sort position in the interface lists.
